details.description: Hermes 3 70B is a general-purpose chat model from Nous Research, fine-tuned from Meta's Llama 3.1 70B base model. It is built for advanced agentic function-calling, complex roleplay and internal monologue, and long multi-turn conversations, with an emphasis on letting users steer its behavior through system prompts. It uses the ChatML prompt format and is OpenAI-API compatible.
advantages: Nous Research describes the model as offering 'advanced long-term context retention and multi-turn conversation capability, complex roleplaying and internal monologue abilities, and enhanced agentic function-calling.'
Supports function calling and structured JSON-mode outputs.
Uses the ChatML prompt format with system-prompt steering, which Nous Research says gives users strong control over the model's behavior.
disadvantages: Nous Research states Hermes 3 performs only 'comparably' to the Llama 3.1 70B Instruct model it is fine-tuned from, with mixed strengths and weaknesses across benchmarks rather than a clear improvement.
use_cases: Agentic applications that call external tools or functions

notes: Catalog facts cap this model at 32768 max input/output tokens. Neither the Hugging Face model card nor the Nous Research Hermes 3 page states an explicit context length for the 70B variant specifically (the base Llama 3.1 70B it is fine-tuned from supports up to 128k), so this could not be confirmed or contradicted against a source; kept the catalog's value and left context length out of the description. No numeric benchmark scores specific to the 70B size were published on either page (only a qualitative 'comparable to Llama 3.1 Instruct' claim), so evaluations is left empty per the instructions to leave it empty rather than guess.
